title: Daniels' Running Formula, 4th Edition
claims: The fourth edition (2022, 320 pages, ISBN 9781718203662) refines Jack Daniels' VDOT system and provides training pace plans.
The VDOT system converts a recent race performance into a fitness value and then into recommended training paces.
The book is a coaching methodology published commercially, not a standard issued by a sports governing body or clinical guideline body.
The publisher's description presents the system as the author's coaching framework rather than a consensus standard.
